top_signals.title: BREAKING: C.H. Robinson acquiring RXO
top_signals.summary:
In a move that may have been foreshadowed by strong upward stock movement Thursday and Friday, C.H. Robinson, the country’s biggest 3PL, is getting a lot bigger by acquiring RXO. The transaction was announced Monday morning.  RXO’s (NYSE: RXO) stock price had risen sharply Thursday and Friday, with it rising Friday by $2.02, a gain […]

top_signals.title: Volare Jumps in Oslo Debut as Wave of Shipping IPOs Builds
top_signals.summary: Volare Shipping Ltd. jumped on its first day of trading in Oslo on Monday after the spin-off arm of Trafigura Group Pte. became the latest in a spree of tanker listings in the Norwegian capital.

top_signals.title: Brazil Assets Surge as Bolsonaro Takes Lead in Election Race
top_signals.summary: Brazilian assets surged as investors jumped to price in a change of government after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro defied polls to come in ahead of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of elections, making him the front-runner to win the Oct. 25 runoff.
